identity.description: Converts JSON input (array of objects, array of arrays, or a single object) into a properly formatted CSV output.

inputs.description: Paste your JSON here. Supports an array of objects, array of arrays, or a single object.

outputs.description: CSV output converted from the JSON input.

skills.name: JSON to CSV
skills.description: Accepts a JSON string and returns a CSV file. Supports arrays of objects (auto-detects headers), arrays of arrays (row-based), and single objects (one-row CSV).
